test_title: PYST 2 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 12 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In the following question, in each option a pair of figures is given. In each pair the figure towards the left of (:) is related by some logic/rule/relation with the figure on the right of (:). Select the odd figure pair from the given alternatives.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/516158148bbabd5e34586723969016030bc36790601800354d7319c6c571e3a0.png] → The middle-most element Triangle in the first image shifts to the centre in the second image.

2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20e74a4a7dbf1ca6becafc1b04cd88c24d45769837926d38b345dc189c079a88.png] → The middle-most element Quadrilateral in the first image shifts to the centre in the second image.

3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b553154cafb208c462e1606840b3f5d884e995951b426b190f44dece124bb36.png] → The middle-most element Rectangle in the first image shifts to the centre in the second image, but the triangle in first image is missing in second image.

4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf5c8c6ceb6afead6216473d08a70a0447f7ec478228d3c8613c33638ead2578.png] → The middle-most element Triangle in the first image shifts to the centre in the second image.

Thus, option 3 image is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
